name: guards
description: Command guards: caps unbounded git log, diff and find, trims long Bash and MCP output and saves the full text to a file, blocks commits that skip hooks or fail the project's checks, limits Reads of large files, tells Claude at session start to delegate lookups and mechanical edits to cheaper subagents, forces context-heavy lookups onto the Haiku context-scout subagent, and, opted in, asks for a browser check after UI edits
